channel.title: WhisperBar — Apple Silicon Updates
channel.description: WhisperBar updates for Apple Silicon Macs.

item.title: WhisperBar 1.20.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Fixed a startup crash on older macOS versions after updating to WhisperBar 1.20.0.

item.title: WhisperBar 1.21.0
item.description:
Improved

  • Custom words are now displayed alphabetically in Settings.

Fixed

  • Fixed audio muting at 0% recording volume when using AirPods or other Bluetooth headphones for both playback and dictation.

item.title: WhisperBar 1.22.0
item.description:
New

  • Added single-key and multi-key shortcuts, with a preview and controls to confirm or discard changes.

Improved

  • Improved the reliability of Transform Selection, including browser text fields and email edits.

Fixed

  • Fixed an issue where Bluetooth headphone audio could become silent shortly after dictation ended.

item.title: WhisperBar 1.22.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Fixed an issue where quickly tapping the Fn key could immediately stop dictation.

item.title: WhisperBar 1.23.0
item.description:
New

  • Press Esc to cancel a running dictation, no matter which app is in front.
  • When Enhance rewrites a dictation, the history keeps your original text so you can view and copy it.

Improved

  • Meeting notes have a clearly labelled Copy notes button that copies the complete notes, including headings and checklists.
  • The last transcription in the menu bar now has a clearly labelled Copy button.

Fixed

  • Meeting notes now stay with their own meeting: opening another meeting from the history no longer shows notes from a different one, and notes are kept after restarting the app.
  • If the microphone stops delivering audio during dictation, WhisperBar now stops the recording, inserts what was captured and tells you, instead of appearing to keep recording.
  • Dictations pasted into Parallels, VMware or remote desktop windows no longer insert the previous clipboard content.
